name: Xebra Brands Ltd.
summary: Xebra Brands Ltd., a Canadian enterprise, is comprehensively engaged in the cannabis industry, overseeing activities from cultivation and processing to manufacturing, product design, and distribution throughout the country. Their diverse product lineup includes an array of cannabis-infused beverages, such as seltzers, soft drinks, iced teas, lemonades, and a variety of energy and sports drinks. Furthermore, the company provides personal care wellness items like capsules, tinctures, topical applications, and intimate oils. These offerings are sold under several distinct brand names, including HighJack, MadCap, Vicious Citrus, Conquer, HolaHi, and HighCastle. Founded in 2019, Xebra Brands Ltd. operates from its main office in Vancouver, Canada.
